The clone now checks out a local branch at REV (`r55-rev`). Discovery plumbing only; predicate, arms, denominators and target unchanged. Found by the L1 dry run on an edited clone before any control was scored and before any deciding invocation.

The note and SKILL arms now match against whitespace-normalized text.
